This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2. This criminal appeal in nature of Section 14-A of the Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 together with amendment Act, 2016 (in short, "the Act") is directed against the order dated 06.05.2025 passed in TR Case No.54 of 2024 by which the learned Additional Sessions Judge-Cum- Special Judge, Jeypore has refused to release the appellant on bail in connection with Jeypore Sadar PS Case No.264 of 2023 for commission of offence punishable U/Ss.376(2)(n)/506 of IPC r/w Sections 3(2)(v)/3(2)(va)/3(1)(r) of the Act, on the main allegation of committing rape upon the victim by taking advantage of her caste.
3. Heard, Mr. Rajendra Narayan Rout, learned counsel for the appellant; Mr. Sudhir Kumar Padhi,
learned counsel for the informant appearing virtually and Mr. P. Satpathy, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record including the copy of deposition of the victim as produced.
4. After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offence alleged against the appellant vis-a-vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the pre trial detention of the appellant in custody since 15.08.2023 with examination of the victim in the meantime and trial having not yet been concluded even after more than two years of custody of the appellant and on going through the evidence of the victim and taking into account the right of the accused to be presumed innocent until proven guilty Sankar Khora vs State Of Orissa And Another on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28015739/
1 at the trial, this Court without expressing any view on the merits, considers it proper to admit the appellant to bail.
5.
